label: holds office in
description: A person formally serves in a state institution or office.

label: leads
description: A person or body leads an institution, party, group, or business.

label: member of
description: A person or organization belongs to a larger body or alliance.

label: aligned with
description: An actor is broadly politically aligned with another actor or bloc.

label: opposes
description: An actor is a recurring political opponent or critic of another actor.

label: regulates
description: A state institution regulates or oversees another actor.

label: owns or controls
description: A person or organization is publicly associated with ownership or control.

label: monitors
description: A civic or watchdog actor monitors another actor or system.

label: covers
description: A media outlet regularly covers a person, body, or issue.

label: negotiates with
description: Two actors engage in recurring diplomatic or political negotiations.

label: authored
description: A person or institution authored a law, draft, project, or formal decision.

label: coauthored
description: A person or institution coauthored a law, draft, project, or formal decision.

label: voted for
description: An actor formally voted in favor of a law, decision, or project.

label: voted against
description: An actor formally voted against a law, decision, or project.

label: implemented by
description: A law, project, or program is implemented by a named actor.

label: challenged in court
description: A law, decision, project, or actor is challenged in court.

label: licensed by
description: An actor or entity is licensed by a public authority.

label: funded by
description: An actor, project, or program is funded by another actor.

label: benefited entity
description: An entity benefits from a decision, program, or procurement.

label: investigated by
description: An actor or case is investigated by a body or newsroom.

label: criticized by
description: An actor, decision, or project is publicly criticized by another actor.

label: publicly supported
description: An actor, law, or project was publicly supported by another actor.

label: publicly opposed
description: An actor, law, or project was publicly opposed by another actor.

label: subject of legal case
description: An actor is the subject of a formal legal case.

label: watchdog allegation
description: A watchdog or civic organization attributed a disputed allegation.

label: media claim disputed
description: A public media claim exists but is disputed or unresolved.

label: contracted with state
description: An actor or company held a formal state contract.

label: director of
description: A person is formally listed as a director or executive officer of a company or legal entity.

label: beneficial owner reported
description: A source reports a beneficial owner or controlling person for a company; admission requires strong provenance.

label: party membership reported
description: A source reports party membership or affiliation; weak or media-only cases remain claims until admitted.

label: municipal roster member
description: A person is listed in a mayoral, municipal council, or local administration roster.

label: involves
description: An event directly involves a person, institution, organization, or project.

label: reported by
description: An event node is evidenced by a media or institutional source.

label: mentions
description: An event or dossier references an entity as context or participant.

label: announced by
description: An event or decision was publicly announced by a named actor.

label: affects
description: An event materially affects a country, institution, group, or policy area.
